info.label: Factory
info.desc: Closer is the second and final studio album by English rock band Joy Division, released on 18 July 1980 by Factory Records. Produced by Martin Hannett, it was released two months after the suicide of the band's lead singer and lyricist Ian Curtis. The album reached No. 6 on the UK Albums Chart, peaked at No. 3 in New Zealand in September 1981, and No. 2 in Greece during August 2020. Closer was also named NME Album of the Year. It was remastered and re-released in 2007. Today, Closer is widely recognized as a seminal release of the post-punk era. .
info.engineers: Jon Caffery, Martin Hannett, Michael Johnson

podcast.body: In *Closer*, the band achieved a more balanced sound where Ian Curtis was less predominant, and his lyrics written in late 1979 and 1980 were noted as being simpler, less passionate, or less depressing, which allowed for a greater focus on the overall band sound and instrumental contributions. "aquí en el closer si que vemos un sonido mucho más de la banda Ian Cortes posiblemente no están predominantes y que es verdad que las letras que compuso Ian Cortes a final de 79 y en el 80 que formarían parte de este close up y eran un poco más vanales no eran como tan pasionales ni tan deprimentes a lo mejor son como un peline más sencillas eso permite focalizarse más en el sonido de la banda y en el sonido del disco."

podcast.body: Recorded between March 18 and 20, 1980, this album featured a deeper, richer, and more haunting vocal delivery from Ian Curtis, achieved through producer Martin Hannett and Tony Wilson making him listen to Frank Sinatra records. It marked the band's artistic progression and intensified their sound of pain and alienation. "Between March 18 and 20, 1980, they started recording a new album that would eventually be called Closer."

podcast.body: Released 20-30 days after Ian Curtis's death, *Closer*'s launch was amplified by the surrounding tragedy, causing it to chart in numerous territories, receive generally good reviews from nearly all magazines (unlike *Unknown Pleasures*), and gain significant popularity outside the UK, with Joy Division appearing on music magazine covers in countries like Australia and Japan during the second half of 1980. "el lanzamiento del closer ya no fue como el no pleasures fue un álbum que sí se llevó a posicionar en los charts en bastantes fue un álbum que sí fue reseñado por casi todas las revistas además con realmente buenas críticas no como increíbles pero sí con bastante buenas críticas y fue un álbum que además fuera del reino unido se hizo bastante popular tenemos portadas de revistas de música en países como australia como incluso en Japón con joydivision durante la segunda mitad de 1980."

podcast.body: Joy Division began recording their second album, *Closer*, in 1980. For many, this album is not as famous as their debut but is considered to be of higher quality, and some fans even regard it as possibly the best Post-Punk work. "primero en 1980 empiezan la grabación del Closer, lo que sería el segundo disco, para muchos no tan famos como el primero, pero sí que posiblemente va a estar de mejor calidad que el segundo."
